name: Drowning in His Restraint
overview: Evelyn reunites with Damon, her father’s dangerously charming best friend, at a luxury resort—and he becomes her temporary summer guardian. A thrilling cat‑and‑mouse game ignites between them, blurring the boundaries of control and rebellion, temptation and taboo. Evelyn is determined to break through Damon’s cold, distant exterior, unaware she’s recklessly playing with fire. Damon initially scoffs at the idea of babysitting the young woman, yet he soon finds himself crossing every dangerous line he swore to keep. What forbidden passion will ignite between the guarded guardian and the bold young rebel this summer?
